composition.stated: This run deliberately keeps the 39557190033 composition so the two full-corpus readings can be compared: the agent phase is normalized to public egress, no filtered-egress probe is run, no contamination gate is enabled, one attempt per cell, each cell's own declared budget, fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1 and the same grader. The only declared delta is the candidate.
composition.whyNotFilteredEgress: Filtered egress changes what a task container can reach, and several cells legitimately install their own dependencies during the agent phase (dna-insert runs apt-get install primer3, code-from-image installs OCR tooling). Turning it on here would measure a different, stricter composition and could not be compared with 39557190033. Filtered egress stays a separate declared arm (see config/frontier-harness-meriyah-filtered-egress-20261022.json).
composition.parallelism: fh_max_parallel=8 is a scheduling choice only: it changes how many cells run concurrently, never a cell's budget, timeout or grader.

mitigation.imageMirror: Five datacurve images were rate-limited (429) during 39557190033's environment builds. The digest-preserving GHCR mirrors seeded for the recovery arm are passed for those five so they are not rebuilt from public.ecr.aws. The remaining four datacurve images and the seven terminal-bench images are pulled from their frozen references; a rate limit there would be recorded as an infra error, exactly as last time.
mitigation.noCleanClaim: Because no contamination gate is enabled and egress is public, this run makes no claim that any cell was uncontaminated. Run 39700728172 is the evidence for why that matters: a cell can read its upstream solution and its patch can still be graded. Any cell whose record is to be used as a capability reading still needs its own contamination receipt.

constraints: One predeclared attempt per cell over the exact frozen corpus; no second attempt in this manifest.
No verdict, frozen record or artifact of 39557190033, 39585210102, 39620264048, 39700728172 or 39721121070 is replaced, repaired or reinterpreted by this run.
Nothing above is read as a model-capability result: this run keeps public egress and no contamination gate, so it cannot separate a model failure from an answer source it may have reached.
Every error cell keeps its mechanical cause (environment build, rate limit, transport, budget) in the record; an error is never counted as a model failure.
No budget, timeout or effort is extended to make any cell scoreable.

knownRisks.ecrRateLimit: The five error cells of 39557190033 all died on `429 Too Many Requests` from public.ecr.aws. Five mirrors are passed above; the other four datacurve images are not mirrored, so an error there is possible and would be recorded as infra, not as a model failure.
knownRisks.transport: 39557190033 lost 2,246 s across six cells to provider transport stalls. Nothing in this candidate claims to fix that, so a stalled cell keeps its mechanical cause.
knownRisks.noContaminationGate: Public egress and no contamination gate: a cell that reaches its upstream solution is not detected here. This run is a refresh of the composition, not a capability reading.
knownRisks.rerun: One attempt per cell. A cell that fails here keeps its canonical verdict; no retry is admitted by this manifest.
